headline: Pixel 11 specs and price leak with no surprises
summary: The Pixel 11's specs and price have reportedly leaked. The device is expected to get a $100 price hike, starting at $899. It will likely come with 256GB storage, aligning with earlier rumors.

headline: Angela Nissel faces down grief with a laugh
summary: Angela Nissel's new memoir, "Good Grief, Pass the Bread, Mom Is Dead," tackles parental loss. The book delivers an emotional story with a unique gallows humor. Nissel uses comedy to navigate the difficult experience of caring for a terminally ill parent.

headline: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
summary: Fenix Flexin's track "Rubberz" hit the Billboard Hot 100, sparking controversy. Many are speculating whether the song was largely created using AI. The former Shoreline Mafia member found solo success with the track, raising questions about its origin.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak racks up millions of views
summary: A bootleg of "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" was widely leaked on X. The film reached over 5.9 million accounts before being taken down. Disney is now actively working to remove all reposted versions of the leak.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: The first official cast photo for "Game of Thrones: The Mad King" stage play has been revealed. Key characters like King Aerys II and Rhaegar Targaryen are featured. Young Ned Stark is also confirmed as part of the stage production's cast.

headline: Vincent Pastore, The Sopranos Actor, Dies at 80
summary: Vincent Pastore, known for his role in "The Sopranos," has passed away at 80. He famously portrayed Salvatore Bonpensiero in the iconic TV series. His death marks a significant loss for the entertainment community.

headline: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
summary: FromSoftware's cryptic social media post has ignited Elden Ring fans. Players are speculating intensely about potential new Godwyn DLC content. This excitement comes two years after the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.

headline: Barbie 2 Will Have to Start from Scratch if Warner Bros. Can't Make a Deal With Talent by December
summary: Negotiations for "Barbie 2" have reportedly stalled, jeopardizing the sequel. Warner Bros. risks losing key talent if deals aren't finalized by December 2026. Director Greta Gerwig, writer Noah Baumbach, and stars Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling may depart.

headline: EU calls emergency meeting to discuss Ceuta migrant crossings
summary: The EU has convened an emergency meeting to address migrant crossings in Ceuta. Tense diplomatic exchanges have occurred between Spain and other EU states. The meeting aims to discuss the significant influx of migrants into the enclave.

headline: A bruising 24 hours - what next for Fifa and under-pressure Infantino?
summary: Pressure is mounting on Gianni Infantino, FIFA's president, after a challenging period. Questions are being raised about his ability to survive as the head of the organization. Recent events have created a difficult situation for FIFA leadership.

headline: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
summary: Renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja has died in a Pakistan avalanche. Purja was famous for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months. His company confirmed the tragic news of his passing.

headline: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
summary: A bomb detonated at a Moscow restaurant, resulting in three fatalities. State media reports a woman attempted to enter with explosives but was stopped. Security officials confirmed the incident and the tragic loss of life.
